rca of the issue: LiveMapPage.js was partially updated for iteration 10. Developer added consumer references to `offices` (defaultCenter, header text, and JSX map render) but forgot to (a) declare useState for offices, and (b) add the fetch to /api/office-locations. Reproduction: navigate to /dashboard/live-map after admin login → page throws 'ReferenceError: offices is not defined', React error boundary/console shows crash, leaflet container never mounts. Mitigation: add `const [offices, setOffices] = useState([]);` near line 52 and inside a useEffect call `api.get('/office-locations').then(({data}) => setOffices(Array.isArray(data) ? data : data.rows || []))`.
